# Hive:Magnus

> Open source tools for self-hosted agents: Hive for suite installation and recovery; Oathweave for identity; Emberpath for model routing; HiveMem for memory; HiveSkills for distribution; HiveXUI for the shared browser console; Magnus for Linux fleet operations and the Ardent runtime; Cindertrace for security investigations, cases, and evidence; ChatterMost for conversation; Emberfold for context continuity.

These projects can be used independently. Integrations are optional and require configuration. Ardent belongs to the Magnus repository and bundles the Emberfold library; a separate Emberfold HTTP service is not required. This website publishes documentation and sample UI captures, not a hosted agent service or installation endpoint. The products use Apache-2.0; extracted suite products remain candidates pending publication and migration acceptance.

Guides include prerequisites, documented commands, expected results, and the public source revision reviewed. Follow the linked current repository documentation for upgrades and configuration changes. Before editing a repository, read its AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [Site overview](https://hivemagnus.com/index.md): Project selection, optional connections, and documentation links in Markdown.
- [Hive guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hive.md): Published legacy launcher and candidate Bash suite boundary.
- [Magnus and Ardent guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/magnus.md): Install the fleet manager or run Ardent independently with bundled Emberfold.
- [Cindertrace guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/cindertrace.md): Install standalone security operations, configure optional sources and integrations, use the dedicated upgrade runbook, or try the isolated three-stage investigation lab with external agents and simulated containment.
- [ChatterMost guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/chattermost.md): Verify and install the versioned Compose distribution and connect an agent.
- [Emberfold guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberfold.md): Run a synthetic CLI dry run or use the TypeScript library; optional HTTP and Hermes interfaces.

## Repository instructions

- [Hive AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChefTaco/hive/main/AGENTS.md): Repository setup, checks, and contribution guidance.
- [Magnus AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChefTaco/magnus/main/AGENTS.md): Repository setup, checks, and contribution guidance for Magnus and Ardent.
- [Cindertrace AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChefTaco/cindertrace/main/AGENTS.md): Privacy gates, security boundaries, setup, and verification.
- [ChatterMost AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChefTaco/ChatterMost/main/AGENTS.md): Installation runbook and repository checks.
- [Emberfold AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChefTaco/emberfold/main/AGENTS.md): Repository setup, contracts, and verification.

## Extracted product candidates

- [Emberpath candidate guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberpath.md): External providers, model routing, aliases, quotas and telemetry.
- [Oathweave candidate guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/oathweave.md): Identity, authentication, authorization, browser sign-in and service identities.
- [HiveMem candidate guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivemem.md): Memory storage, retrieval, sessions, graph evidence, consolidation and workspaces.
- [HiveSkills candidate guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hiveskills.md): Skills registry, immutable archives, channels, assignments and distribution.
- [HiveXUI candidate guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivexui.md): Shared strict TypeScript, React and Vite browser application.
